<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Grind Theory Skate Co. | Shop, Ride, Learn</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Skateboard shop and lesson studio. Decks, trucks, wheels, apparel, and lessons for every level.">
  <style>
    :root {
      --asphalt: #121212;
      --asphalt-2: #1c1c1c;
      --chalk: #f4f1ea;
      --chalk-dim: #bdb8ad;
      --acid: #ff5a1f;
      --acid-dark: #d94512;
      --mint: #34d3b0;
      --line: rgba(244, 241, 234, 0.14);
      --radius: 14px;
      --display: "Arial Black", "Helvetica Neue", Impact, sans-serif;
      --body: "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: var(--body);
      background: var(--asphalt);
      color: var(--chalk);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* Concrete texture applied to background sections */
    .grit {
      background-color: var(--asphalt);
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 1px, transparent 1px),
        radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 3px 3px, 7px 7px;
      background-position: 0 0, 2px 3px;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    .wrap {
      width: min(1160px, 92%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--acid);
      margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
    }

    h1, h2, h3 {
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 0.95;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.4rem);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0; }

    .lead {
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 60ch;
    }

    section { padding: clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem) 0; position: relative; }

    .section-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 2rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.95rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      border: 2px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform .15s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, input:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid var(--mint);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }
    .btn-primary { background: var(--acid); color: #111; }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: #ff7a4a; }
    .btn-ghost { border-color: var(--chalk); color: var(--chalk); background: transparent; }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--chalk); color: var(--asphalt); }
    .btn-dark { background: var(--asphalt); color: var(--chalk); }
    .btn-dark:hover { background: #000; }

    /* Header */
    header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      background: rgba(18, 18, 18, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 74px;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .logo small {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.62rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 3px;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.8rem;
      list-style: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }
    .nav-links a { opacity: 0.85; transition: opacity .2s, color .2s; }
    .nav-links a:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--acid); }
    .nav-cta { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center; }
    .cart-count {
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 22px; height: 22px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--mint);
      color: #071a15;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-left: 4px;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      padding: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6.5rem) 0 clamp(4rem, 8vw, 6rem);
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 0 58%, rgba(255,90,31,0.10) 58% 59%, transparent 59%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #161616, var(--asphalt));
    }
    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      gap: 3rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 8.2vw, 6.6rem);
      margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    }
    .hero h1 .outline {
      color: transparent;
      -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--chalk);
    }
    .hero h1 .hot { color: var(--acid); }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.9rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 2.2rem;
      margin-top: 2.8rem;
      padding-top: 1.6rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-stats strong {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 1.9rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .hero-stats span { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--chalk-dim); }

    .hero-art {
      position: relative;
      height: 520px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
    }
    .hero-art .sticker {
      position: absolute;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transform: rotate(-6deg);
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000;
    }
    .sticker.a { top: 30px; left: 0; background: var(--mint); color: #061611; }
    .sticker.b { bottom: 50px; right: 0; background: var(--chalk); color: #111; transform: rotate(5deg); }

    .deck {
      width: min(380px, 90%);
      transform: rotate(-14deg);
      filter: drop-shadow(18px 24px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.55));
      animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes float {
      0%,100% { transform: rotate(-14deg) translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: rotate(-11deg) translateY(-14px); }
    }

    /* Marquee */
    .ticker {
      background: var(--acid);
      color: #111;
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-block: 2px solid #000;
    }
    .ticker-track {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 2.5rem;
      padding: 0.85rem 0;
      animation: slide 28s linear infinite;
      font-family: var(--display);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
    .ticker-track span::after {
      content: "✱";
      margin-left: 2.5rem;
      font-family: var(--body);
    }
    @keyframes slide { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

    /* Shop */
    .shop-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .cat {
      background: var(--asphalt-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.6rem;
      transition: transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      min-height: 280px;
    }
    .cat:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--acid); }
    .cat svg { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin-bottom: auto; }
    .cat h3 { margin: 1.2rem 0 0.4rem; }
    .cat p { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .cat .count {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mint);
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .staff-picks {
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .pick {
      background: var(--chalk);
      color: #111;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 1.4rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr;
      gap: 1.1rem;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .pick .art {
      height: 110px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--c1), var(--c2));
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .pick .art::after {
      content: attr(data-tag);
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px; left: 8px;
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      background: #111;
      color: var(--chalk);
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .pick h4 { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
    .pick .price { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .pick .price s { color: #777; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-left: 6px; }
    .pick .add {
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 3px;
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: #111;
      font-family: inherit;
      padding: 0;
    }

    /* Lessons */
    .lessons { background: #0d0d0d; }
    .plans {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .plan {
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 2.2rem 1.8rem;
      background: var(--asphalt-2);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
    }
    .plan.featured {
      border: 2px solid var(--acid);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #241611, var(--asphalt-2));
      transform: translateY(-10px);
    }
    .plan .badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: -14px; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--acid);
      color: #111;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .plan h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .plan .who { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-size: 0.92rem; margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
    .plan .amount {
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 3rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .plan .amount small {
      font-family: var(--body);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .plan ul {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 1.6rem 0 2rem;
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }
    .plan li::before {
      content: "→";
      color: var(--mint);
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-right: 0.6rem;
    }
    .plan .btn { margin-top: auto; justify-content: center; }

    .lesson-note {
      margin-top: 2.5rem;
      display: flex;
      gap: 2rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
    }
    .lesson-note strong { color: var(--chalk); }

    /* Coaches */
    .coaches-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .coach {
      background: var(--asphalt-2);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .coach-top {
      height: 230px;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--bg);
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
    }
    .coach-top .initials {
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 5rem;
      color: rgba(0,0,0,0.22);
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
    }
    .coach-top .tag {
      position: absolute;
      left: 14px; bottom: 14px;
      background: #111;
      color: var(--chalk);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
    }
    .coach-body { padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem; }
    .coach-body p { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-size: 0.93rem; margin-top: 0.4rem; }

    /* Testimonials */
    .quotes {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }
    .quote {
      border-left: 4px solid var(--mint);
      padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;
    }
    .quote p { font-size: 1.02rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .quote footer { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--chalk-dim); }
    .quote footer strong { color: var(--chalk); display: block; }

    /* Booking */
    .booking {
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,90,31,0.15), transparent 45%),
        var(--asphalt);
    }
    .booking-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 3.5rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .steps { list-style: none; margin-top: 2rem; display: grid; gap: 1.2rem; counter-reset: s; }
    .steps li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .steps li::before {
      counter-increment: s;
      content: counter(s, decimal-leading-zero);
      font-family: var(--display);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--acid);
      color: var(--acid);
    }
    .steps strong { display: block; }
    .steps span { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-size: 0.93rem; }

    form.book {
      background: var(--chalk);
      color: #111;
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 2.2rem;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.1rem;
      box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 #000;
    }
    .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; }
    .field.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    .field label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
      font: inherit;
      padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 2px solid #111;
      background: #fff;
      color: #111;
    }
    .field textarea { min-height: 80px; resize: vertical; }
    form.book button {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      background: #111;
      color: var(--chalk);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      transition: background .2s;
    }
    form.book button:hover { background: var(--acid); color: #111; }
    .form-msg {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      min-height: 1.4em;
    }

    /* Visit */
    .visit-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .info-card {
      background: var(--asphalt-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 2rem;
    }
    .info-card dl {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      gap: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.97rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }
    .info-card dt { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-weight: 600; }
    .info-card dd { font-weight: 600; }
    .map {
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      min-height: 360px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 49%, #2a2a2a 49% 51%, transparent 51%),
        linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 49%, #2a2a2a 49% 51%, transparent 51%),
        linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 47%, #242424 47% 49%, transparent 49%),
        #161616;
      background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 180px 180px, auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .map .pin {
      position: absolute;
      left: 52%; top: 45%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
      background: var(--acid);
      color: #111;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 10px 10px 10px 0;
      box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000;
      transform-origin: bottom left;
    }
    .map .label {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px; bottom: 16px;
      background: rgba(18,18,18,0.85);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    /* Footer */
    footer.site {
      background: #070707;
      padding: 4rem 0 2rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .foot-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1.3fr;
      gap: 2.5rem;
    }
    .foot-grid h4 {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .foot-grid ul { list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .foot-grid a:hover { color: var(--acid); }
    .foot-grid p { color: var(--chalk-dim); font-size: 0.95rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .subscribe { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .subscribe input {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background: var(--asphalt-2);
      color: var(--chalk);
      font: inherit;
    }
    .subscribe button {
      padding: 0 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 0;
      background: var(--acid);
      color: #111;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
    }
    .legal {
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--chalk-dim);
    }

    /* Reveal animation */
    .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
    .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation: none !important;
        transition: none !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }
      .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1000px) {
      .shop-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .staff-picks { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .plans { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }
      .plan.featured { transform: none; }
      .coaches-grid, .quotes { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .booking-grid, .visit-grid, .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-art { height: 380px; }
      .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .shop-grid, .coaches-grid, .quotes { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      form.book { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 1.5rem; }
      .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .nav-cta .btn-ghost { display: none; }
      .info-card dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.2rem; }
      .info-card dt { margin-top: 0.6rem; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <header>
    <div class="wrap nav">
      <a href="#top" class="logo" aria-label="Grind Theory home">
        <svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 34 34" aria-hidden="true">
          <circle cx="17" cy="17" r="16" fill="#ff5a1f"/>
          <path d="M8 22 L17 9 L26 22 Z" fill="#121212"/>
          <circle cx="17" cy="23" r="2.5" fill="#f4f1ea"/>
        </svg>
        <div>GRIND THEORY<small>SKATE CO. · EST. 2014</small></div>
      </a>

      <nav aria-label="Primary">
        <ul class="nav-links">
          <li><a href="#shop">Shop</a></li>
          <li><a href="#lessons">Lessons</a></li>
          <li><a href="#coaches">Coaches</a></li>
          <li><a href="#booking">Book</a></li>
          <li><a href="#visit">Visit</a></li>
        </ul>
      </nav>

      <div class="nav-cta">
        <a href="#shop" class="btn btn-ghost" style="padding:0.6rem 1.1rem;font-size:0.88rem;">

  <script>
    // Reveal-on-scroll
    const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
      const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((e) => {
          if (e.isIntersecting) {
            e.target.classList.add('in');
            io.unobserve(e.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.12 });
      reveals.forEach((el) => io.observe(el));
    } else {
      reveals.forEach((el) => el.classList.add('in'));
    }

    // Cart button demo
    let cartCount = 0;
    const cartBadge = document.querySelector('.cart-count');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-add]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        cartCount++;
        cartBadge.textContent = cartCount;
        cartBadge.setAttribute('aria-label', cartCount + ' items');
        btn.textContent = 'Added ✓';
        setTimeout(() => (btn.textContent = 'Add to cart'), 1400);
      });
    });

    // Booking form
    const bookForm = document.getElementById('bookForm');
    const formMsg = document.getElementById('formMsg');
    bookForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = bookForm.name.value.trim();
      const email = bookForm.email.value.trim();
      const date = bookForm.date.value;
      if (!name || !email || !date) {
        formMsg.style.color = '#b3260b';
        formMsg.textContent = 'Add your name, email, and a date to continue.';
        return;
      }
      if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) {
        formMsg.style.color = '#b3260b';
        formMsg.textContent = 'That email looks off. Double-check it?';
        return;
      }
      formMsg.style.color = '#0b6b5a';
      formMsg.textContent = 'Thanks ' + name.split(' ')[0] + '! We\'ll confirm your session by email shortly.';
      bookForm.reset();
    });

    // Newsletter
    const subForm = document.getElementById('subForm');
    const subMsg = document.getElementById('subMsg');
    subForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const val = subForm.querySelector('input').value.trim();
      if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(val)) {
        subMsg.style.color = '#ff8a5c';
        subMsg.textContent = 'Enter a valid email address.';
        return;
      }
      subMsg.style.color = 'var(--mint)';
      subMsg.textContent = 'You\'re in. Watch your inbox.';
      subForm.reset();
    });

    // Set minimum booking date to today
    const dateInput = document.getElementById('date');
    if (dateInput) {
      dateInput.min = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    }
  </script>
